title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Towel Bar Solid Brass | Autumn Sparkle | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double With Towel Bar | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds two levels of organization plus a built-in towel bar in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. This Waverly Place collection design pairs 3/8-inch thick tempered glass with solid brass hardware, and a gallery rail helps keep items in place.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass hardware with a solid brass gallery rail to help secure items
- Integrated towel bar provides a convenient spot to hang towels
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look

Specs:
- Overall size: 16-inch length x 5-inch width x 12-inch height (5-inch projection)
- Weight capacity: 4 lb
- Mounting: wall mount
- Assembly: no assembly required
- Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Style: traditional; coordinates with transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories in the Waverly Place collection
